method: Full page JS in isolated VM; synthetic SDK only; no production requests

results.name: normal field round trip, including nulls, units, date, dropped media and settings
offline create, reload and retry preserve local records and accurate status
missing SDK/table/schema never reports synced and never writes malformed properties
late initial query cannot overwrite an edit created during the read
response lost after successful add is reconciled by stable ID with no second add
habit add then rapid decrement to zero finishes as a tombstone, not an active zero row
custom same-name habits stay separate; archive/restore preserves definitions and check-ins
independent edits merge; competing edits keep both and require a visible choice
delete while offline remains deleted after reload and second-device reads
legacy income note, unknown dates and recoverable local-only fields survive migration
quota failure never sends unpersisted mutation; damaged local data is preserved
duplicate stable IDs block writes instead of silently choosing a record
malformed complete payload blocks the entire read before replacing local state
legacy pendingAdd is removed and failed check-in can sync after reload
